LanguageData.DDAF_PlayerDiplomacy: Diplomacy changes can involve your faction
LanguageData.DDAF_PlayerDiplomacyDesc: Every 6 hours, with the chance below, a random NPC faction makes peace with you (if hostile) or turns hostile. Goodwill moves just far enough to change the relation (peace: 0, war: -75). Follows the diplomacy change, permanent enemy, exclude Empire and ideo bloc settings above. Added by Dynamic Diplomacy Arena Fixes.
